lyrics:
[FORM — establish the musical world]
[Arrangement: sampled breakbeats, sub-bass, chopped vocals, and bright digital stabs]
[SOUND SOURCE ROLES: assign MBIRA=ANCHOR.]
[Production: tiny transistor-radio bandwidth as a recurring contrast]
[Rhythm establishes: breakbeat chopping with preserved backbeat landmarks]
[Vocal behavior establishes: tight polyphonic counterpoint with independent lyric timing]
[ADDRESSEE: ANONYMOUS CALLER — change what the lyric assumes, explains, withholds, repeats, or asks.]
[TUNING: 11-LIMIT JUST INTONATION — make interval relationships obey this pitch world instead of defaulting silently to 12-TET.]
[RHYTHMIC PHYSICS: POLYMETER — keep every selected clock/cycle/process audible and separately traceable.]
[SPATIAL AUDIO: CONCENTRIC RINGS — placement and movement must change arrangement behavior, not just stereo width.]
[SCALE ENGINE: MOLECULAR — change which objects, causes, measurements, and operations are available at this scale.]
[EPISTEMOLOGY: KNOWS EVERYTHING / CANNOT EXPLAIN IT — enforce who knows what, what counts as evidence, and how information may be acquired or disclosed.]
[AUDIENCE FEEDBACK: HECKLING CHANGES LYRICS — listener reaction must causally alter a named compositional variable.]
[CONTROL AUTHORITY: PERCUSSIONIST — only the authorized controller may make designated changes until authority transfers.]
Subject: Recursion/fractal.
The first pass is deliberately legible. The listener is given a stable specimen before any mutation begins.
SUBSTRATE SMUGGLER controls substrate transfer.
Nothing else is permitted to steal that jurisdiction.
[FORMAT — MOTIVATIONAL SEMINAR]
Turns self-improvement rhetoric into an escalating group ritual.
[JURISDICTION: Sequence, recurring segments, turn-taking, lyric architecture, and event/media mechanics.]
[SCALE ENGINE — MOLECULAR]
Chemistry becomes the native action vocabulary.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: The physical or conceptual scale at which events are described and therefore which causes, objects, and operations are available.]
[EPISTEMOLOGY / KNOWLEDGE — KNOWS EVERYTHING / CANNOT EXPLAIN IT]
The truth is available internally but cannot be transmitted cleanly.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: What each narrator or performer knows, does not know, incorrectly knows, or is allowed to reveal.]
[AUDIENCE FEEDBACK — HECKLING CHANGES LYRICS]
The crowd can rewrite what the singer has to say next.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: How listeners, callers, judges, dancers, or crowds causally alter meter, harmony, lyrics, instrumentation, or form.]
[CONTROL AUTHORITY — PERCUSSIONIST]
The clock-holder becomes the structural boss.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: Which agent is allowed to make compositional changes and how authority transfers, rotates, or is contested.]
[SOUND PALETTE / SOURCE — MBIRA]
Create cycling interlocks whose composite pattern emerges from overlapping simple figures.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: The acoustic, electronic, biological, mechanical, environmental, or object-based materials that physically produce the sound.]
[LANGUAGE / PHONOLOGY — ENGLISH]
Dense clusters plus aggressive vowel reduction make a strong contrast with syllable-timed profiles.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: Phonological inventory, phonotactics, prosody, syllable behavior, and language-specific mouth mechanics.]
[LANGUAGE PERFORMANCE MODE — ENGLISH WITH L1 PHONOLOGICAL TRANSFER]
English sung through the selected language’s phonological habits rather than a cartoon accent.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: Whether lyrics use the selected language, English with first-language transfer, code-switching, chant, patter, phonotactic nonsense, or another defined performance mode.]
[ADDRESSEE / RELATIONSHIP — ANONYMOUS CALLER]
Unknown identity turns ordinary conversation into cautious information exchange.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: Who is being addressed and therefore what is assumed, explained, hidden, begged for, threatened, translated, or repeated.]
[TUNING / PITCH WORLD — 11-LIMIT JUST INTONATION]
Higher-prime ratios widen the native harmonic vocabulary without abandoning exact-ratio structure.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: Pitch relationships, interval behavior, reference pitch, temperament, and allowable pitch-space organization.]
[RHYTHMIC PHYSICS — POLYMETER]
Several bar structures coexist over one pulse and periodically realign.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: Pulse organization, cycle length, subdivision, phase, polymeter, density, acceleration, and temporal-grid behavior.]
[STAGE GEOMETRY / SPATIAL AUDIO — CONCENTRIC RINGS]
Radius becomes a formal dimension.
[COMPOSITION JURISDICTION: Where performers and sound sources exist relative to one another and the listener, including motion, distance, direction, and shared acoustic space.]
[Anchor appears: three compact notes or syllables, clean and memorable.]
Record the anchor exactly. It will return after the system damages everything around it.

[DESTABILIZE — separate jurisdictions begin negotiating]
